decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual speakers rather than accessories like cases or straps. My consideration set includes a high-end home setup (Edifier), a mid-range performance speaker (DOSS), a reliable refurbished brand name (JBL), and two budget/novelty options (comiso and AOLWEEC). I chose the JBL Charge 4 (Renewed) because it provides the best performance-to-price ratio from a reputable audio brand. Although it is renewed, the rating is very high and the price point of $89.95 is competitive with the DOSS while offering better brand recognition and expected sound signature.
